'''Malachor II''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Malachor system/Legends|Malachor system]].

==History==
Malachor II was a member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and one of the planets which [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]] led an excavation on.<ref name="SWTORCiGC">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Expedition into the Unknown|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
